name: Programming
description: Prepares students to program computers in support of work in any area of study. A short path to programming literacy that can be completed in four terms. Majors in Computer Science and joint programs with Economics, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Psychology, or Computing and the Arts may not pursue this certificate.
notes: None of the five required courses may satisfy a major or other certificate; substitute from the same category or a more advanced course if needed
No course may satisfy more than one of the five required courses
Majors in Computer Science, CSEC, CS-EE, CS-Math, CS-Psychology, or Computing and the Arts may not pursue this certificate

requirements.name: Prerequisite
requirements.description: Introductory programming course. AP Computer Science credit may satisfy this prerequisite.

requirements.name: Programming elective
requirements.description: A CPSC course with CPSC 2230 as a listed or implied prerequisite and a primary focus on programming, or a second course that satisfies the advanced programming requirement.

requirements.name: Applications or algorithms elective
requirements.description: Either a programming-in-context course that requires significant programming, or a course in algorithms.
